controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate access control policy and procedures.

controls.title: Account Management
controls.description: Define and document types of system accounts. Create, enable, modify, disable, and remove accounts. Monitor and report account usage.

controls.title: Access Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for logical access to information and system resources.

controls.title: Information Flow Enforcement
controls.description: Enforce approved authorizations for controlling the flow of information within the system and between connected systems.

controls.title: Separation of Duties
controls.description: Identify and document duties requiring separation. Define system access authorizations to support separation of duties.

controls.title: Least Privilege
controls.description: Employ the principle of least privilege, allowing only authorized accesses that are necessary for users to accomplish assigned organizational tasks.

controls.title: Unsuccessful Logon Attempts
controls.description: Enforce a limit of consecutive invalid logon attempts by a user. Automatically lock the account when the maximum number is exceeded.

controls.title: System Use Notification
controls.description: Display a system use notification message before granting access informing users of applicable conditions of use.

controls.title: Concurrent Session Control
controls.description: Limit the number of concurrent sessions for each system account.

controls.title: Device Lock
controls.description: Prevent further access to the system by initiating a device lock after a period of inactivity.

controls.title: Session Termination
controls.description: Automatically terminate a user session after defined conditions or trigger events.

controls.title: Permitted Actions Without Identification or Authentication
controls.description: Identify and document user actions that can be performed without identification or authentication.

controls.title: Remote Access
controls.description: Establish and document usage restrictions and implementation guidance for each type of remote access allowed. Authorize each type before use.

controls.title: Wireless Access
controls.description: Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for each type of wireless access.

controls.title: Access Control for Mobile Devices
controls.description: Establish configuration requirements, connection requirements, and implementation guidance for organization-controlled mobile devices.

controls.title: Use of External Systems
controls.description: Establish terms and conditions for authorized individuals to access the system from external systems.

controls.title: Information Sharing
controls.description: Enable authorized users to determine whether access authorizations assigned to a sharing partner match the access restrictions on the information.

controls.title: Publicly Accessible Content
controls.description: Designate individuals authorized to make information publicly accessible. Review publicly accessible information for nonpublic information. Remove nonpublic information.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate awareness and training policy and procedures.

controls.title: Literacy Training and Awareness
controls.description: Provide security and privacy literacy training to system users including awareness of the need for operations security.

controls.title: Role-Based Training
controls.description: Provide role-based security and privacy training to personnel with assigned security roles before authorizing access.

controls.title: Training Records
controls.description: Document and monitor information security and privacy training activities.

controls.title: Training Feedback
controls.description: Provide feedback on organizational training results on an ongoing basis.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate audit and accountability policy and procedures.

controls.title: Event Logging
controls.description: Identify types of events that the system is capable of logging in support of the audit function.

controls.title: Content of Audit Records
controls.description: Ensure that audit records contain information that establishes what type of event occurred, when it occurred, where it occurred, the source, the outcome, and the identity of individuals or subjects.

controls.title: Audit Log Storage Capacity
controls.description: Allocate audit log storage capacity to accommodate anticipated audit log volume.

controls.title: Response to Audit Logging Process Failures
controls.description: Alert designated personnel in the event of an audit logging process failure and take additional actions.

controls.title: Audit Record Review, Analysis, and Reporting
controls.description: Review and analyze system audit records for indications of inappropriate or unusual activity and report findings.

controls.title: Audit Record Reduction and Report Generation
controls.description: Provide and implement an audit record reduction and report generation capability that supports on-demand audit review, analysis, and reporting.

controls.title: Time Stamps
controls.description: Use internal system clocks to generate time stamps for audit records.

controls.title: Protection of Audit Information
controls.description: Protect audit information and audit logging tools from unauthorized access, modification, and deletion.

controls.title: Non-repudiation
controls.description: Provide irrefutable evidence that an individual performed certain actions within the system.

controls.title: Audit Record Retention
controls.description: Retain audit records for a defined period to provide support for after-the-fact investigations and meet regulatory retention requirements.

controls.title: Audit Record Generation
controls.description: Provide audit record generation capability for the event types the system is capable of auditing. Allow designated personnel to select events to be audited.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate assessment, authorization, and monitoring policy and procedures.

controls.title: Control Assessments
controls.description: Develop a control assessment plan and assess the controls in the system and its environment of operation to determine effectiveness.

controls.title: Information Exchange
controls.description: Approve and manage the exchange of information between the system and other systems using interconnection security agreements.

controls.title: Plan of Action and Milestones
controls.description: Develop a plan of action and milestones for the system to document planned remediation actions.

controls.title: Authorization
controls.description: Assign a senior official as the authorizing official for the system. Ensure the authorizing official authorizes the system before commencing operations.

controls.title: Continuous Monitoring
controls.description: Develop a system-level continuous monitoring strategy and implement continuous monitoring program.

controls.title: Penetration Testing
controls.description: Conduct penetration testing on systems or system components.

controls.title: Internal System Connections
controls.description: Authorize, document, and manage internal connections to the system.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate configuration management policy and procedures.

controls.title: Baseline Configuration
controls.description: Develop, document, and maintain a current baseline configuration of the system.

controls.title: Configuration Change Control
controls.description: Determine and document types of changes to the system that are configuration-controlled.

controls.title: Impact Analyses
controls.description: Analyze changes to the system to determine potential security and privacy impacts prior to change implementation.

controls.title: Access Restrictions for Change
controls.description: Define, document, approve, and enforce physical and logical access restrictions associated with changes to the system.

controls.title: Configuration Settings
controls.description: Establish and document configuration settings for components employed within the system using security configuration checklists.

controls.title: Least Functionality
controls.description: Configure the system to provide only mission-essential capabilities. Prohibit or restrict the use of functions, ports, protocols, and services.

controls.title: System Component Inventory
controls.description: Develop and document an inventory of system components that accurately reflects the system and is consistent with the authorization boundary.

controls.title: Configuration Management Plan
controls.description: Develop, document, and implement a configuration management plan.

controls.title: Software Usage Restrictions
controls.description: Use software and associated documentation in accordance with contract agreements and copyright laws.

controls.title: User-Installed Software
controls.description: Establish and enforce policies governing the installation of software by users.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate contingency planning policy and procedures.

controls.title: Contingency Plan
controls.description: Develop a contingency plan that identifies essential mission and business functions, provides recovery objectives and metrics, and addresses contingency roles and responsibilities.

controls.title: Contingency Training
controls.description: Provide contingency training to system users consistent with assigned roles and responsibilities.

controls.title: Contingency Plan Testing
controls.description: Test the contingency plan to determine effectiveness and organizational readiness.

controls.title: Alternate Storage Site
controls.description: Establish an alternate storage site and initiate agreements to permit storage and retrieval of system backup information.

controls.title: Alternate Processing Site
controls.description: Establish an alternate processing site that provides security measures equivalent to the primary site.

controls.title: Telecommunications Services
controls.description: Establish alternate telecommunications services to support the system if primary services are unavailable.

controls.title: System Backup
controls.description: Conduct backups of user-level, system-level, and system documentation information.

controls.title: System Recovery and Reconstitution
controls.description: Provide for the recovery and reconstitution of the system to a known state within an established time period after a disruption.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate identification and authentication policy and procedures.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Organizational Users)
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate organizational users and associate that unique identification with processes acting on behalf of those users.

controls.title: Device Identification and Authentication
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate devices before establishing a connection.

controls.title: Identifier Management
controls.description: Manage system identifiers by receiving authorization to assign an individual, group, role, service, or device identifier.

controls.title: Authenticator Management
controls.description: Manage system authenticators by verifying the identity of the individual, group, role, service, or device as part of the initial authenticator distribution.

controls.title: Authentication Feedback
controls.description: Obscure feedback of authentication information during the authentication process to protect the information from possible exploitation.

controls.title: Cryptographic Module Authentication
controls.description: Implement mechanisms for authentication to a cryptographic module that meet applicable requirements.

controls.title: Identification and Authentication (Non-Organizational Users)
controls.description: Uniquely identify and authenticate non-organizational users or processes acting on behalf of non-organizational users.

controls.title: Re-authentication
controls.description: Require users to re-authenticate when defined circumstances or situations require re-authentication.

controls.title: Identity Proofing
controls.description: Identity proof users that require accounts for logical access to systems based on appropriate identity assurance level requirements.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate incident response policy and procedures.

controls.title: Incident Response Training
controls.description: Provide incident response training to system users consistent with assigned roles and responsibilities.

controls.title: Incident Response Testing
controls.description: Test the effectiveness of the incident response capability.

controls.title: Incident Handling
controls.description: Implement an incident handling capability that includes preparation, detection and analysis, containment, eradication, and recovery.

controls.title: Incident Monitoring
controls.description: Track and document system security and privacy incidents.

controls.title: Incident Reporting
controls.description: Require personnel to report suspected incidents to the organizational incident response capability within required time periods.

controls.title: Incident Response Assistance
controls.description: Provide an incident response support resource that offers advice and assistance to users of the system for the handling and reporting of incidents.

controls.title: Incident Response Plan
controls.description: Develop an incident response plan that provides the organization with a roadmap for implementing its incident response capability.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate maintenance policy and procedures.

controls.title: Controlled Maintenance
controls.description: Schedule, document, and review records of maintenance, repair, and replacement on system components.

controls.title: Maintenance Tools
controls.description: Approve, control, and monitor the use of system maintenance tools.

controls.title: Nonlocal Maintenance
controls.description: Approve and monitor nonlocal maintenance and diagnostic activities.

controls.title: Maintenance Personnel
controls.description: Establish a process for maintenance personnel authorization and maintain a list of authorized maintenance organizations or personnel.

controls.title: Timely Maintenance
controls.description: Obtain maintenance support and spare parts within a defined time period of failure for system components.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate media protection policy and procedures.

controls.title: Media Access
controls.description: Restrict access to digital and non-digital media to authorized individuals.

controls.title: Media Marking
controls.description: Mark system media indicating distribution limitations, handling caveats, and applicable security markings.

controls.title: Media Storage
controls.description: Physically control and securely store digital and non-digital media within controlled areas.

controls.title: Media Transport
controls.description: Protect and control digital and non-digital media during transport outside of controlled areas.

controls.title: Media Sanitization
controls.description: Sanitize system media prior to disposal, release out of organizational control, or release for reuse.

controls.title: Media Use
controls.description: Restrict or prohibit the use of portable storage devices on system components.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate physical and environmental protection policy and procedures.

controls.title: Physical Access Authorizations
controls.description: Develop, approve, and maintain a list of individuals with authorized access to the facility.

controls.title: Physical Access Control
controls.description: Enforce physical access authorizations at entry and exit points to the facility.

controls.title: Access Control for Transmission
controls.description: Control physical access to system distribution and transmission lines within organizational facilities.

controls.title: Access Control for Output Devices
controls.description: Control physical access to output from output devices to prevent unauthorized individuals from obtaining the output.

controls.title: Monitoring Physical Access
controls.description: Monitor physical access to the facility where the system resides to detect and respond to physical security incidents.

controls.title: Visitor Access Records
controls.description: Maintain visitor access records to the facility where the system resides.

controls.title: Power Equipment and Cabling
controls.description: Protect power equipment and power cabling for the system from damage and destruction.

controls.title: Emergency Shutoff
controls.description: Provide the capability of shutting off power to the system or individual system components in emergency situations.

controls.title: Emergency Power
controls.description: Provide an uninterruptible power supply to facilitate an orderly shutdown of the system in the event of a primary power source loss.

controls.title: Emergency Lighting
controls.description: Employ and maintain automatic emergency lighting for the system that activates in the event of a power outage.

controls.title: Fire Protection
controls.description: Employ and maintain fire detection and suppression systems that are supported by an independent energy source.

controls.title: Environmental Controls
controls.description: Maintain temperature and humidity levels within the facility where the system resides at acceptable levels.

controls.title: Water Damage Protection
controls.description: Protect the system from damage resulting from water leakage by providing master shutoff valves.

controls.title: Delivery and Removal
controls.description: Authorize and control system components entering and exiting the facility and maintain records of the items.

controls.title: Alternate Work Site
controls.description: Employ management, operational, and technical controls at alternate work sites equivalent to those at the primary site.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate planning policy and procedures.

controls.title: System Security and Privacy Plans
controls.description: Develop security and privacy plans for the system that are consistent with the enterprise architecture.

controls.title: Rules of Behavior
controls.description: Establish and provide to individuals requiring access to the system the rules that describe their responsibilities and expected behavior.

controls.title: Baseline Selection
controls.description: Select a control baseline for the system.

controls.title: Baseline Tailoring
controls.description: Tailor the selected control baseline by applying specified tailoring actions.

controls.title: Information Security Program Plan
controls.description: Develop and disseminate an organization-wide information security program plan.

controls.title: Information Security Program Leadership Role
controls.description: Appoint a senior information security officer with the mission and resources to coordinate, develop, implement, and maintain an organization-wide information security program.

controls.title: Information Security and Privacy Resources
controls.description: Include the resources needed to implement the information security and privacy programs.

controls.title: Plan of Action and Milestones Process
controls.description: Implement a process to ensure that plans of action and milestones for the information security, privacy, and supply chain risk management programs are maintained.

controls.title: System Inventory
controls.description: Develop and maintain an inventory of organizational systems.

controls.title: Measures of Performance
controls.description: Develop, monitor, and report on the results of information security and privacy measures of performance.

controls.title: Risk Management Strategy
controls.description: Develop a comprehensive strategy to manage security risk, privacy risk, and supply chain risk to organizational operations.

controls.title: Authorization Process
controls.description: Manage the security and privacy state of organizational systems through authorization processes.

controls.title: Mission and Business Process Definition
controls.description: Define organizational mission and business processes with consideration for information security and privacy.

controls.title: Testing, Training, and Monitoring
controls.description: Implement a process for ensuring that plans for testing, training, and monitoring associated with controls are developed and maintained.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate personnel security policy and procedures.

controls.title: Position Risk Designation
controls.description: Assign a risk designation to all organizational positions. Establish screening criteria for individuals filling those positions.

controls.title: Personnel Screening
controls.description: Screen individuals prior to authorizing access to the system.

controls.title: Personnel Termination
controls.description: Upon termination of individual employment, disable system access within a defined time period.

controls.title: Personnel Transfer
controls.description: Review and confirm ongoing operational need for current logical and physical access authorizations when individuals are reassigned or transferred.

controls.title: Access Agreements
controls.description: Develop and document access agreements for organizational systems. Review and update the access agreements.

controls.title: External Personnel Security
controls.description: Establish personnel security requirements for external providers and monitor provider compliance.

controls.title: Personnel Sanctions
controls.description: Employ a formal sanctions process for individuals failing to comply with established information security and privacy policies and procedures.

controls.title: Position Descriptions
controls.description: Incorporate security and privacy role responsibilities into organizational position descriptions.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate PII processing and transparency policy and procedures.

controls.title: Authority to Process Personally Identifiable Information
controls.description: Determine and document the legal authority that permits the processing of personally identifiable information.

controls.title: Personally Identifiable Information Processing Purposes
controls.description: Identify and document the purpose for processing personally identifiable information.

controls.title: Consent
controls.description: Implement tools or mechanisms for individuals to consent to the processing of their personally identifiable information.

controls.title: Privacy Notice
controls.description: Provide notice to individuals about the processing of personally identifiable information.

controls.title: System of Records Notice
controls.description: Publish system of records notices in the Federal Register for systems containing personally identifiable information.

controls.title: Specific Categories of Personally Identifiable Information
controls.description: Apply processing conditions for specific categories of personally identifiable information.

controls.title: Computer Matching Requirements
controls.description: Implement applicable requirements when entering into computer matching agreements.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate risk assessment policy and procedures.

controls.title: Security Categorization
controls.description: Categorize the system and information it processes, stores, and transmits.

controls.title: Risk Assessment
controls.description: Conduct a risk assessment to identify threats to and vulnerabilities of the system.

controls.title: Vulnerability Monitoring and Scanning
controls.description: Monitor and scan for vulnerabilities in the system and hosted applications.

controls.title: Risk Response
controls.description: Respond to findings from security and privacy assessments, monitoring, and audits.

controls.title: Criticality Analysis
controls.description: Identify critical system components and functions by performing a criticality analysis.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate system and services acquisition policy and procedures.

controls.title: Allocation of Resources
controls.description: Determine the high-level information security and privacy requirements for the system.

controls.title: System Development Life Cycle
controls.description: Acquire, develop, and manage the system using a system development life cycle that incorporates information security and privacy considerations.

controls.title: Acquisition Process
controls.description: Include security and privacy functional requirements in the acquisition contract for the system.

controls.title: System Documentation
controls.description: Obtain or develop administrator documentation and user documentation for the system.

controls.title: Security and Privacy Engineering Principles
controls.description: Apply systems security and privacy engineering principles in the specification, design, development, implementation, and modification of the system.

controls.title: External System Services
controls.description: Require that providers of external system services comply with organizational security and privacy requirements.

controls.title: Developer Configuration Management
controls.description: Require the developer of the system to perform configuration management during design, development, implementation, and operation.

controls.title: Developer Testing and Evaluation
controls.description: Require the developer of the system to create and implement a security and privacy assessment plan.

controls.title: Unsupported System Components
controls.description: Replace system components when support for the components is no longer available from the developer, vendor, or manufacturer.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate system and communications protection policy and procedures.

controls.title: Separation of System and User Functionality
controls.description: Separate user functionality from system management functionality.

controls.title: Information in Shared System Resources
controls.description: Prevent unauthorized and unintended information transfer via shared system resources.

controls.title: Denial-of-Service Protection
controls.description: Protect against or limit the effects of denial-of-service attacks by employing controls.

controls.title: Boundary Protection
controls.description: Monitor and control communications at the external managed interfaces to the system and at key internal boundaries within the system.

controls.title: Transmission Confidentiality and Integrity
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of transmitted information.

controls.title: Network Disconnect
controls.description: Terminate the network connection associated with a communications session at the end of the session or after a defined period of inactivity.

controls.title: Cryptographic Key Establishment and Management
controls.description: Establish and manage cryptographic keys when cryptography is employed within the system.

controls.title: Cryptographic Protection
controls.description: Determine the cryptographic uses and implement the types of cryptography required for each specified cryptographic use.

controls.title: Collaborative Computing Devices and Applications
controls.description: Prohibit remote activation of collaborative computing devices and applications and provide an explicit indication of use to users.

controls.title: Public Key Infrastructure Certificates
controls.description: Issue public key certificates under an organizational policy or obtain public key certificates from an approved service provider.

controls.title: Mobile Code
controls.description: Define acceptable and unacceptable mobile code and mobile code technologies. Establish implementation guidance for acceptable mobile code.

controls.title: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Authoritative Source)
controls.description: Provide additional data origin authentication and integrity verification artifacts along with the authoritative name resolution data.

controls.title: Secure Name/Address Resolution Service (Recursive or Caching Resolver)
controls.description: Request and perform data origin authentication and data integrity verification on name/address resolution responses.

controls.title: Architecture and Provisioning for Name/Address Resolution Service
controls.description: Ensure the systems that collectively provide name/address resolution service are fault-tolerant and implement role separation.

controls.title: Session Authenticity
controls.description: Protect the authenticity of communications sessions.

controls.title: Protection of Information at Rest
controls.description: Protect the confidentiality and integrity of information at rest.

controls.title: Process Isolation
controls.description: Maintain a separate execution domain for each executing system process.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate system and information integrity policy and procedures.

controls.title: Flaw Remediation
controls.description: Identify, report, and correct system flaws. Install security-relevant software and firmware updates.

controls.title: Malicious Code Protection
controls.description: Implement malicious code protection mechanisms at system entry and exit points to detect and eradicate malicious code.

controls.title: System Monitoring
controls.description: Monitor the system to detect attacks and indicators of potential attacks, unauthorized local/network/remote connections.

controls.title: Security Alerts, Advisories, and Directives
controls.description: Receive system security alerts, advisories, and directives from designated organizations on an ongoing basis.

controls.title: Security and Privacy Function Verification
controls.description: Verify the correct operation of security and privacy functions.

controls.title: Software, Firmware, and Information Integrity
controls.description: Employ integrity verification tools to detect unauthorized changes to software, firmware, and information.

controls.title: Spam Protection
controls.description: Employ spam protection mechanisms at system entry and exit points to detect and act on unsolicited messages.

controls.title: Information Input Validation
controls.description: Check the validity of information inputs to the system.

controls.title: Error Handling
controls.description: Generate error messages that provide information necessary for corrective actions without revealing information that could be exploited.

controls.title: Information Management and Retention
controls.description: Manage and retain information within the system and information output from the system in accordance with applicable laws and policies.

controls.title: Memory Protection
controls.description: Implement controls to protect the system memory from unauthorized code execution.

controls.title: Policy and Procedures
controls.description: Develop, document, and disseminate supply chain risk management policy and procedures.

controls.title: Supply Chain Risk Management Plan
controls.description: Develop a plan for managing supply chain risks associated with the development, acquisition, maintenance, and disposal of systems.

controls.title: Supply Chain Controls and Processes
controls.description: Establish a process to identify and address weaknesses or deficiencies in the supply chain elements and processes.

controls.title: Acquisition Strategies, Tools, and Methods
controls.description: Employ acquisition strategies, contract tools, and procurement methods to protect against, identify, and mitigate supply chain risks.

controls.title: Supplier Assessments and Reviews
controls.description: Assess and review the supply chain-related risks associated with suppliers or contractors.

controls.title: Notification Agreements
controls.description: Establish agreements with suppliers and contractors regarding notification of supply chain compromises.

controls.title: Inspection of Systems or Components
controls.description: Inspect systems or system components to detect tampering.

controls.title: Component Authenticity
controls.description: Develop and implement anti-counterfeit policy and procedures that include means to detect and prevent counterfeit components.

controls.title: Component Disposal
controls.description: Dispose of system components using organization-defined techniques and methods.
